overclaims: The investigation attributes the fatal Mountain View crash partly to Autopilot steering outside the travel lane because of vision-processing limitations, alongside driver distraction and ineffective engagement monitoring.
checks.note: The statement excerpt, proposition, contract and outcome are fine, and the rationale matches the NTSB probable-cause text. The e1 citation fails. Its public excerpt is cut down to the fragment "Contributing to the crash", which supports nothing alone, and the full exact words cover driver-monitoring, not Autopilot steering. The e1 explanation also says "vision-processing limitations", but the evidence says only "system limitations", so that detail is unsupported.
